question: The Norman Borlaug National Excellence Award is given for excellence in which research field?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Agricultural Sciences**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coromandel International**, a fertilizer manufacturer, bestows the Borlaug Award.
 
• This honour is given to **Indian scientists** in recognition of their work and contributions to the environmental and agricultural fields.
 
• This prize was established in 1972 and is named in honour of **Norman Borlaug**, a Nobel Prize winner known as the "**Father of the Green Revolution**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
